families.imageContract: single image; anyres grids 1..6; max9 packed spatial budget; 384 crop
families.generation: greedy max16; 24 layers; 2 KV heads; head dimension64; empty-past Prefill plus named past/present Decode
families.unsupported: multi-image, video, region grounding, Beam, sampling, tool calling, JSON mode

ownership: NativeMultimodalSession owns three exact named backend sessions and one Profile/artifact/source-bound packed image state. Tokenizer, Registry, external files, and prepared input remain caller-owned. Each Generate owns transient KV tensors; only an immutable final KV summary is published.
publication: External metadata only. No binary is uploaded or downloadable until license, notice/source obligations, immutable release URI, and explicit upload authorization are independently approved.
